content.user_title: Build a Complete Software Testing Strategy
content.value_statement: Unclear test priorities leave critical behavior exposed and waste automation effort. This skill creates risk-based plans, coverage targets, test cases, and CI quality gates.
actual_capabilities: Defines risk-based coverage targets for critical paths, business logic, APIs, and user interfaces.
Selects unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance test layers for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python projects.
Structures test plans and test cases with reusable templates and coverage checklists.
Applies test data, mocking, isolation, parameterization, and behavior-focused design patterns.
Maps automated tests into CI stages with measurable quality gates and execution schedules.
limitations: The skill does not execute tests or verify runtime results by itself.
Examples focus on JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, so other ecosystems require adaptation.
Suggested coverage percentages are starting points, not compliance or defect-free guarantees.
Performance examples use placeholder endpoints and require environment-specific safety limits.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Feature
use_cases.description: Build a risk-based test plan before implementation, including critical paths, coverage targets, and acceptance criteria.

use_cases.title: Close Coverage Gaps
use_cases.description: Turn coverage reports and defect history into a prioritized backlog of valuable automated tests.

use_cases.title: Create CI Quality Gates
use_cases.description: Assign test suites to commit, pull request, staging, and production stages with clear failure thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a test plan for [feature] in [stack]. List risks, unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, with measurable acceptance criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting test planning for one feature.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Coverage Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [coverage summary] for [system]. Identify critical gaps, rank them by business risk, and propose focused tests with coverage targets.

prompt_templates.title: Design CI Quality Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Design CI quality gates for [repository] using [tools]. Define test stages, failure thresholds, reporting, and schedules for commits, pull requests, and deployments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Adding continuous testing to delivery workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Risk-Based Testing Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a risk-based testing architecture for [platform]. Balance unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security tests against [constraints] and [release risks].
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinating test strategy across a complex platform.

output_examples.input: Plan testing for a checkout flow with payment, inventory, and confirmation email dependencies.
output: Critical paths: authorization, payment capture, inventory reservation, rollback, and order confirmation.
Unit tests cover pricing, discounts, validation, and state transitions.
Integration tests verify payment, inventory, database, and notification contracts using controlled test services.
End-to-end tests cover successful checkout, declined payment, depleted inventory, and safe retry behavior.

output_examples.input: Improve a service with strong line coverage but recurring authorization defects.
output: Prioritize branch and permission-matrix coverage over increasing the overall line percentage.
Add role, ownership, tenant, expired-session, and privilege-escalation scenarios at API boundaries.
Block merges when authorization tests fail or critical policy branches lose coverage.

best_practices: Prioritize tests by business impact, failure likelihood, and recovery cost.
Test observable behavior and contracts instead of private implementation details.
Keep tests isolated, deterministic, and assigned to the fastest suitable test layer.
anti_patterns: Do not treat high line coverage as proof that important behavior is protected.
Do not place every scenario in slow end-to-end suites.
Do not use production credentials, customer data, or uncontrolled endpoints in tests.

faq.question: Which test types does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers static analysis, unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and continuous testing strategy.

faq.question: Does it support JavaScript and Python?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes Jest, Vitest, Playwright, pytest, k6, Locust, and related coverage tools.

faq.question: Will it run or install testing tools?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and recommendations, but tool installation or execution requires explicit action in your environment.

faq.question: Can it define coverage targets?
faq.answer: Yes. It proposes risk-based targets for critical paths, business logic, APIs, interfaces, and new features.

faq.question: Can it create CI quality gates?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps test suites to delivery stages and defines coverage, failure, security, and performance thresholds.

faq.question: Does high coverage guarantee software quality?
faq.answer: No. Coverage measures execution, so the strategy also emphasizes assertions, risk, behavior, isolation, and production-relevant scenarios.
